archive_list — FILEIO archive op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.archive_list(data_or_path) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.archive_list(data_or_path); from the registry, opsfileio.get("archive_list"))

Usage

List archive member names, expanded and compressed sizes, modification times, and directory flags.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

bytes または path を受け、行は name/size/compressed_size/modified/is_dir を持つ。zip と tar 系は標準ライブラリ、7z/rar は 7-Zip が見つかる場合だけ扱う。7-Zip 不在や壊れた書庫では空一覧にせず例外にする。Example: rows = archive_list(zip_bytes).
